scope.zh: 12项真实尝试的执行状态、文件哈希与限制；首轮和后续恢复分开，不计算总通过率。
scope.en: Execution states, hashes and limits for twelve real attempts, separating first attempts from recovery without an overall pass rate.

rawTraceAvailability: Original session IDs are recorded; complete per-session raw-request and tool-trace export was not audited.
snapshotCaveat: Late review snapshot, not a receipt captured at each worker termination.
